contexts.text: Man's foot represents what is natural.
The Hells are under the feet.
The feet = natural things.
Wash your feet () = that the Divine should put on something natural. AC 2332.
That the feet = natural things, may be evident from the representatives in the other life, and from the derivative representatives with the most ancient people, and so in the Word... Illustrated.
The sense of the letter is signified by the feet.
The spiritual are signified by... those who are conjoined to His feet (). The feet = what is lower, thus what is more obscure, in the Lord's Kingdom.
I came to an abode where heat took possession of the feet. I was told that those who had indulged in pleasures were there...

Water to wash his feet () = purification there... The feet = natural things, or, what is the same, the things which are in the natural man. In the representative Church it was customary to wash the feet with water, and thereby to signify that the dirt of the natural man was washed off, (which is) all things of the love of self and of the world.

He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet () = that he who is being reformed needs to be cleansed only as to natural things, that is, that evils and falsities be removed thence... Moreover to wash the feet was an act of charity, meaning that they did not reflect upon the evils of another; and it was also an act of humiliation, meaning that the man would cleanse another from evils, and as it were from dirt. AC 3148. AC 7442:3. AC 10047:5.
It was customary for travellers to wash their feet when they entered any house. Illustrated.
(The Jews) appear under the plane of the left foot.
Cast under the feet, thus outside the Grand Man.
The infernals (appear) feet upwards.
They are under the feet in Hell.
Jacob lifted up his feet () = the elevation of the Natural.

It is from correspondence with the Grand Man that the feet = the Natural, or natural things... In the Grand Man, those belong to the province of the feet who are in natural light and but little in spiritual light. Hence it is that the things which are beneath the feet, as the sole and the heel, = the lowest natural things; and a shoe... the corporeal Natural, which is the ultimate.
Jehovah hath blessed thee at thy foot () = from the Divine which the Natural had.
The feet, in the internal sense, = natural good.

By the foot which is to be cut off if it should offend (), is meant the Natural which constantly sets itself in opposition to the Spiritual; and that it is to be destroyed if it attempts to weaken truths.
To the foot of the work which is before me () = according to general things... It is said the foot of the work, and afterwards the foot of the children, because the foot = the Natural. AC 4383.
They who appear at the feet are they who are natural; and they who appear at the soles are grosser Spirits of the same kind.
The Lower Earth is immediately under the feet...
On the correspondence of the feet, etc., with the Grand Man. General article.

They who in the Grand Man correspond to the feet, soles, and heels, are they who are natural; and therefore the feet in the Word = natural things; the soles, lower natural things; and the heels, the lowest natural things. For the celestial things in the Grand Man constitute the head, the spiritual things the body, and the natural things the feet...

Once, when I was elevated into Heaven, it appeared to me as if my head were there, my body below, and my feet still lower. It was thence perceived how the higher and lower things with man correspond to the things in the Grand Man, and how the one flows into the other, namely the Celestial... into the Spiritual... and finally into the Natural... Hence it is evident that natural things are like feet on which higher things rest...
They who are in the Lower Earth correspond to the feet and soles; their places, too, are under the feet and soles... They are such as had been in natural delight and not in spiritual.
Under the left foot, a little to the left, are such as had attributed all things to nature... DMin 4722.
The natural, that is, those with whom the Natural has dominated, appear in the light of Heaven feet upwards...
It was shown that a communication exists (from the loins) through the feet with the soles and heels...
He made spiral turnings about the feet, by which was represented that they wanted to insinuate themselves by such things in nature as are delightful.
Their Hell is in a deep place under the right foot...
And his foot () = all the power in the Natural... For to lift up the foot... = power; but... power in the Natural... The Ultimate Heaven relates to the feet. The reason... is... that it is natural.
These Hells are partly... under the right foot. SE 2843:end.
They washed their feet () = the consequent purification of the Natural.
He appeared under the feet.
Spirits who rose up from the deep to the side of the sole of the right foot. AC 6318.
The feet = the things which are of the Natural.

A lawgiver from between his feet () = the truths which are from (the Celestial Kingdom) in lower things... It is said from between his feet, that the truth from good may be signified; for that interior part of the feet, from its communication with the loins, has this signification.
To make the feet like those of hinds () = the Natural in the freedom of the affections.
The feet together with the soles = the outermost things.

He gathered up his feet to the bed () = as to his lower things in which are interior things, to the good and truth of the lower Natural. To gather up the feet = to betake himself to lower things... The feet = the things which are of the Natural, thus which are lower things.
Thy feet sunk in the mire () = hat the Natural is in evil.
Put off thy shoes from off thy feet () = that the sensuous things which are the external things of the Natural were to be removed... The feet = the Natural.
The Natural with man is external, middle, and internal; the internal Natural is signified by the feet, the middle Natural by the soles, and the external by the shoes.
The centre of gravity is where the Lord is in His Sun... thither are the feet of the infernals elevated.
Made it touch his feet () = that the quality of the Natural at that time was shown.

It is said the people that is at thy feet (); for Moses represents truth Divine; and... at thy feet = those who are beneath, thus who are subordinate; for the feet = lower things, because they = natural things.
The people at his feet = all and each who are in truth from the Divine.
Feet = what is natural.
Foot for foot () = if (they shall injure) anything of the power of natural truth.
The feet = the things which are of the natural man; in general, what is natural. References.
External or natural good was represented by the right foot.
Under His feet () = the ultimate sense, which is the sense of the letter. The feet = natural things; thus the soles, which are under the feet = the ultimates of nature. AC 9873:5.

As the Word in the letter is natural, and natural things are signified by the feet, the ultimate of the Word, like the ultimate of the Church, is called the place of the feet of Jehovah, and His foot stool. Illustrated.
Good is to truth as the body is to the arms and feet. Without the arms and feet, the body cannot move itself.
Which are for the four feet thereof () = in the natural sphere... Feet = what is natural. References.

The bases (of the boards) correspond to the feet and soles of the feet in man; in general to the bones... and by the feet and by the bones is in like manner signified truth supporting... The feet = what is natural, thus truth in power from good. References.
The place of the soles of My feet () = the Ultimate Heaven.

All preservation depends on the state of the ultimates... Ultimates are as the soles and the feet, on which the whole body rests... Hence it is, that... the soles and the feet correspond to the ultimates of Heaven.
The wheels of the cherubs have a like signification to that of the arms and feet in man, namely, the power of acting, and of making progress, which is of truth from good.
The feet correspond to the Ultimate Heaven, where there is natural good.
The feet (of Nebuchadnezzar's statue) = the last state of the Church.
In general... the feet = natural good, which is the good and truth of faith. References.
As ultimate things = all things, or the whole... the feet are also taken for them.
The feet correspond to the good of faith, thus to the good of obedience, which is the good of the Ultimate Heaven, and is called the Divine Natural.
All the representatives in nature have reference to the human form; as... the foundation of a house (which) has a like signification to that of the feet and the soles.

His hands and his feet () = the interiors and exteriors of man... For when both hands and feet are mentioned, there is signified whatever is in the internal and also in the external man, or spiritual and natural things. Hence it is that to lift up the hand = power in the Spiritual; and to lift up the foot, power in the Natural. Besides, by the extremes of man are signified all things of him, and the extremes are the hands and feet. Hence it is evident why Aaron and his sons washed their hands and feet when they entered the Tent of the Assembly, or approached the altar to minister.
To turn the foot from the Sabbath () = such things as are of the natural man.
The three Heavens... follow each other and subsist among themselves as the... head... the body... and the feet.
The Ultimate Heaven forms the feet down to the soles, and also the arms down to the fingers. TCR 608.
They who are in the feet are in the ultimate good of Heaven, which good is called spiritual natural.
Hence it is that... by the feet (in the Word) is signified what is natural.
His feet like unto fine brass, as if glowing in a furnace () = Divine natural good. The feet of the Lord = His Divine Natural...
In Heaven, they who are in... the Divine Natural constitute the feet.
The feet, soles, and heels correspond to the natural things in man, and therefore, in the Word, signify natural things...
Divine natural good is also signified by the feet in the following passages.
As the Lord's Church is beneath the Heavens, and is thus under the Lord's feet, it is called the footstool of His feet. Illustrated.
To wash the feet = to purify the natural man; and when this is purified, the whole man is purified. AE 666:2.
As the feet = the Natural of man, and this perverts all things if it is not purified, the Lord says, If thy foot cause thee to offend, cut it off...
By His feet is meant the Word in the natural sense.
To receive and acknowledge truths is signified by to come and worship at thy feet (); not at theirs, but at the Lord's feet, from whom they have the truths from good. (The same is signified in ).
His feet as pillars of fire () = the Lord's Divine Natural as to Divine love, which supports all things.

He set his right foot upon the sea, and his left upon the earth () = that the Lord has the universal Church under His auspices and dominion... To set his feet upon them = to have all things subject to Himself.

They stood upon their feet () = natural life agreeing with spiritual life, and thus to be vivified by the Lord... By standing upon the feet the external of man is signified... Every man is reformed first as to his internal man... (and then) the external man is reformed by speaking and doing the things which the internal man wills and loves... Man is not regenerated before, because (then) his internal... is like a man without feet to stand and walk upon... This is what is signified by the two witnesses standing upon their feet, after the spirit of life from God had entered into them. Illustrated. ( = new life. AE 666, Illustrated.)
The moon under her feet () = the Church about to be on earth, which is the new Jerusalem.

The moon was seen under the woman's feet, because the Church on earth is meant, which was not yet conjoined with the Church in the Heavens... Generally, the Church itself, when conjoined, is signified by the feet.
The new comers undergo a change, and in the eyes of the Angels appear... with feet like those of calves or leopards.
Instead of feet (the devil) had bony ankles without flesh.
The ankles of his feet were like two vipers.
So long as a man lives in this world... Hell is under his feet...
On the washing of feet. WE 4949. WE 3007.
That (creatures) with many feet signify the more insane devils.
(Stumbling with the foot is caused by evil Spirits.)
That in the left foot up to the knee dwell those who being natural correspond to the celestial.
On a sea beneath the feet.

I perceived cold... from the sole of the foot, through the foot up to the knee... first in the right foot, and then in the left... The Spirits who rose up through the right foot were such as had lived in absolute ignorance... such as exist among the lowest of the people... And those who ascended so cold through the left foot were in like manner from the lowest of the people, but who had utterly denied the life after death... SE 3551.
When thinking of places they drew back the foot...
Order is terminated in material things; and when some Spirits lose them... they seem to themselves to lose their feet.
I supposed it was a foot for these Spirits to stand upon.
The Sirens descended into the Hell which is before the left foot... SE 4633:end. SE 4634.
They in flowed into the lowest parts of the left foot, because they were more sensuous than the rest.
They who are in the feet do not perceive as the rest do...

As the Ultimate Heaven corresponds to the feet, by the feet is signified the good of natural love from spiritual love, which is the good of faith; because this good reigns there and makes that Heaven.

His feet like unto burnished brass, as if glowing in a furnace = the ultimate of Divine order, which is the Natural, full of Divine love. (AE 153.) The feet = the Natural; therefore, in reference to the Lord, the ultimate of Divine order, because that is the Natural. AE 153:2, Explained. AE 153:3, Illustrated.
To come and worship at thy feet = to be outside of Heaven and to want to be admitted but not to be able.
To unshoe the soles of the feet () = to reveal the filthy things of nature.
The right foot = the Natural as to good.
Under Wing, see this reference.
The right hand and the right foot = the intelligence and power of truth from good in the internal man and in the external.
The feet = the natural man. AE 475:7.
Nor a lawgiver from between his feet = that neither shall the truths of the Word recede from its ultimate sense.
The good of love from which are the truths of the Word in the sense of the letter, is signified by Let him dip his foot in oil ().

To stand upon their feet () means upon the bones without the flesh, by which is signified that they will become utterly corporeal natural. The feet = the things which are of the natural man; here, the lowest things of it.
To wash the hands and feet = to purify the natural man.
See My hands and My feet ()... By the hands and the feet are signified the ultimates of man. AE 619:15.
He stamped the residue with his feet () = that the things which they could not pervert and destroy they defiled and obliterated by the evils of natural and corporeal loves.
The feet = the things which are of the natural man; therefore to stand upon them () = to live from these things alone.

He set his right foot upon the sea, and his left upon the earth = the sense of the letter which is natural, in which are all things of Heaven and the Church. The feet, when predicated of the Angel, by whom is meant the Lord as to the Word, = Divine truth in ultimates, or the Word in the natural sense... The feet, in the general sense, = natural things, because man, from head to the soles of the feet corresponds to Heaven... and the feet correspond to the Ultimate Heaven, the Angels of which are celestial natural and spiritual natural; whereas the soles of the feet correspond to the world, in which everything is natural.
The dominion of the Lord over all things of Heaven and the Church is meant by, Thou hast put all things under his feet ().

The place of the Lord's feet, in the general sense, = all things of Heaven and the Church, because the Lord as a Sun is above the Heavens. But, in the particular sense, by the place of His feet is signified the Church; for the Lord's Church is with men in the natural world, and the Natural is the ultimate in which the Divine ceases, and upon which it subsists. Hence the Church on earth is also called the stool of the feet of Jehovah. Illustrated.
To walk there upon the earth with the feet, is to touch and draw in the exhalations from the Hells with the corporeal Natural, which corresponds to the soles of the feet...

To tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture () = to destroy so that it does not exist, which is done by reasonings from the corporeal Sensuous, and from the natural man separated from the spiritual. This, therefore, is to tread down with the feet.
To disturb the residue of the waters with your feet () = to confuse the truths not defiled with falsities by means of reasonings from the natural man.
When by the Lord is meant the Word, by His feet is meant the Word in its ultimates, that is, in the sense of its letter.
The moon under her feet = faith with those who are natural and in charity.

The reason the moon was seen under the feet, is that those who are in the Heavens which are under the Lord as a Moon have nothing in common with those who are in the Heavens which are under the Lord as a Sun...

The work of a sapphire stone under His feet () = Divine truth in ultimates, such as is the Word in the letter; for the soles of the feet = the ultimate, which alone could be seen by the Jewish nation.
Their foot did not swell () = that the natural man was not injured by these afflictions.
As the feet = natural things, the feet of the bear () = the fallacies from which by means of reasonings they falsify the sense of the letter... AR 573.
